capability.few_shot: During a visit, the glasses see a friend leave a blue power bank with a cat sticker on the living-room sofa. Other black and blue chargers appear elsewhere during the evening. After the friend leaves, they phone and describe 'my blue power bank with the cat sticker.' The wearer repeats that description to the assistant.
